SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch REPORT
Date November 9, 1937.

Subject Chung Hwa Youth National Salvation Acceleration Association -
Application for Registration.

Made by D.S.I. Shih Ssu-chien Forwarded by C. Crawford

The Chung Hwa Youth National Salvation Acceleration
Association came into existence in the early part of October,
1937, with the object of participating in movements of a
national salvation nature and red cross work. The chairman of
the organization, one Mr. Van Foh, alias Van Tien Chiao (范天樵)
is a graduate of the Shanghai Party Affairs' Training School,
Nantao, and was formerly a coal merchant in Hangchow. According
to the application, there are at present 347 members registered
with the Association, the majority of whom are students.

The Association first came to the notice of the
Municipal Police on October 29, 1937, when they detailed three
members to post pamphlets in the Louza district which contained
war news that was later found to be untrue. Those three people
were taken into custody by the Municipal Police attached to
Louza Station but were subsequently released after having been
duly cautioned.

The Association was advised on November 2, 1937,
by members of the Special Branch to register with the Municipal
Council in accordance with Municipal Notification No.4878 of
October 21, 1937.

D.S.I.
D.C. (Special Branch).

This Association suspended activities on November 11,
1937, after a police warning, and according to information
received, the responsible members of the Association have left
for Nanking to continue their activities. C. Crawford
D.I.

（左侧批注：Cannot register & must close.）
（左侧印章：983 15 NOV 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）
（左侧批注：Q.D.d Sh / C 15/11 / S.I. / D.Sh. / (5)）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科第一股 报告
日期：1937年11月9日。

事由：中华青年急进救亡协会——注册申请。

由副督察长施思坚（Shih Ssu-chien）呈报，经克劳福德（C. Crawford）转呈

中华青年急进救亡协会成立于1937年10月初，其宗旨为参与救国运动及红十字会工作。该组织主席范佛先生，别名范天樵，系南市上海党务训练学校毕业生，前曾在杭州从事煤炭生意。据申请书称，目前在该协会注册的会员有347人，其中大多数为学生。

该协会首次引起工部局警务处注意是在1937年10月29日，当时该会派遣三名成员在老闸区张贴传单，其中包含的战争新闻后被证实为不实消息。这三名人员被隶属于老闸捕房的工部局警员拘留，但在受到正式警告后随即获释。

1937年11月2日，特务科成员告知该协会，应根据1937年10月21日第4878号市政通告向工部局注册。

副督察长
助理总监（特务科）。

该协会在受到警方警告后，于1937年11月11日停止活动，据收到的情报显示，该协会负责成员已前往南京继续其活动。克劳福德
督察长

（左侧批注：不予注册，必须关闭。）
（左侧印章：983 1937年11月15日 上海公共租界工部局警务处）
（左侧批注：Q.D.d Sh / C 15/11 / S.I. / D.Sh. / (5)）

Chung Hwa Youth National Salvation Association - formation.
(中華青年急進救亡協會)
Made by D.S.I. Shih Ssu-chien Forwarded by C. Gauda & Q.

A new political organization known as the Chung Hwa
Youth national Salvation Acceleration Association has recently
come into existence with an office at No.66 Tsingtao Road
(Sinza District). The object of this association is, as that
of many other national salvation associations, the participation
in movements of a patriotic nature. The association is divided
into four sections, namely:
1. The War Zone Service Section;
2. The Propaganda Section;
3. The Stage Plays Section;
4. The Choral Section.
At present some 300 persons are reported to have
registered with the above association, but no attempt has yet
been made by the Association to register with the Municipal
Council.
The following individuals are the promoters and
responsible executive members of the said organization:-
Mr. Van Foh (范佛), Executive member of the
Kuomintang Headquarters in the Kiangying Hsien;
Mr. Chien Sih Yoong (錢奕永), a clerk in the employ
of lawyer Tih Sz Kyi (翟世基);
Mr. Tsang Sung Ts (張純之), secretary of the
Chekiang Province Garrison Commander's Hdqr.;
Mr. Woo Hsien Foong (胡賢丰) a student;
Mr. Zung Ping (陳彬) Secretary of the local Tangpu;
Mr. Zung Han Chi (陳漢奇), an artist;
Mr. Wen Ying Ping (溫應冰) a graduate of the
Whampoa Academy;
Mr. Zung Tsi Zung (陳濟人) a medical practitioner;

中华青年救亡协会——成立。
(中華青年急進救亡協會)
由副督察长施思坚（Shih Ssu-chien）呈报，经高德（C. Gauda）及 Q. 转呈

一个名为“中华青年急进救亡协会”的新政治组织最近成立，办事处设在青岛路66号（新闸区）。该协会的宗旨与许多其他救国协会一样，是参与爱国性质的运动。该协会分为四个部门，即：
1. 战区服务部；
2. 宣传部；
3. 话剧部；
4. 合唱部。
据悉，目前有约300人在上述协会注册，但该协会尚未尝试向工部局注册。
下列人员为该组织的发起人和负责执行成员：
范佛（Van Foh）先生，江阴县国民党总部执行委员；
钱奕永（Chien Sih Yoong）先生，律师翟世基（Tih Sz Kyi）雇用的职员；
张纯之（Tsang Sung Ts）先生，浙江省卫戍司令部秘书；
胡贤丰（Woo Hsien Foong）先生，学生；
陈彬（Zung Ping）先生，当地塘浦秘书；
陈汉奇（Zung Han Chi）先生，艺术家；
温应冰（Wen Ying Ping）先生，黄埔军校毕业生；
陈济人（Zung Tsi Zung）先生，执业医师；

Translation of Despatch No. 33085 dated November 24, 1937,
from the Shanghai Telegraph Office of the Ministry of
Communications.
------------

Major K.M. Bourne,
Deputy Commissioner, S.M. C.

In accordance with your inquiry regarding the
programmes of our broadcasting station (XQHC), I have
to inform you that these programmes have been changed from
time to time. The daily broadcasts include Chinese and
foreign music, news and market quotations which appear in
the daily newspapers. Besides these, we also broadcast
programmes relating to scientific knowledge, lessons in
various foreign languages and other educational programmes.
No programmes relating to politics or war, or songs attacking
any of the Powers are used. It is therefore requested that
these programmes be allowed to continue and a reply to this
letter be sent to me.

Pao K'o Yung,
Director.

（批：X Further it has come under direct
action by Japanese authorities,
so action by us now requires
further enquiry.
28/11.
Bourne）

伯恩（K.M. Bourne）少校，
上海公共租界工部局副总监。

根据贵方对我广播电台（XQHC）节目的查询，本人谨此通知，这些节目不时有所变更。每日广播包括中外音乐、新闻以及日报上刊登的市场行情。除此之外，我们还广播有关科学知识、各种外语课程及其他教育类节目。不使用任何涉及政治或战争的节目，也不使用攻击任何列强的歌曲。因此，恳请允许这些节目继续播出，并对此信予以回复。

鲍克勇（Pao K'o Yung），
